name: stri_endswith_fixed
title: Determine if the Start or End of a String Matches a Pattern

origin.description: Report whether a literal pattern ends at a code-point position.
origin.usage: stri_endswith_fixed(str, pattern, to = -1L, negate = FALSE, ..., opts_fixed = NULL)

arguments.name: to
arguments.text: 1-based code-point index where the match must end. -1 is the end of the string.

arguments.name: negate
arguments.text: If TRUE, report positions that do not match.

origin.details: str, pattern, and to are recycled together. The pattern must end at to. An empty pattern or a missing value is NA. An empty string follows negate. A missing opts_fixed uses case-sensitive search without overlap. A dict may set case_insensitive and overlap. Case-insensitive search maps each code point with ICU u_toupper. A character whose uppercase form is longer than one code point is left unchanged, so ß does not match SS.

translation.description: Report whether a literal pattern ends at a code-point position.
translation.usage: stri_endswith_fixed(str, pattern, to=-1, negate=False, opts_fixed=None, case_insensitive=None, overlap=None)

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: String, missing value, or list of those.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.text: Literal pattern, missing value, or list of those.

arguments.name: to
arguments.text: 1-based code-point index where the match must end. -1 is the end of the string.

arguments.name: negate
arguments.text: If true, report positions that do not match.

arguments.name: opts_fixed
arguments.text: None, or a dict of search settings. Overlap is ignored.

arguments.name: case_insensitive
arguments.text: If given, compare the simple uppercase of each code point.

arguments.name: overlap
arguments.text: Ignored, as in the installed function.

translation.details: str, pattern, and to are recycled together. The pattern must end at to. An empty pattern or a missing value is NA. An empty string follows negate. A missing opts_fixed uses case-sensitive search without overlap. A dict may set case_insensitive and overlap. Case-insensitive search maps each code point with ICU u_toupper. A character whose uppercase form is longer than one code point is left unchanged, so ß does not match SS.
translation.value: A list of True, False, and NA.
translation.example:
from stringi.fixed import stri_endswith_fixed
found = stri_endswith_fixed("ababa", "ba")
print(f'stri_endswith_fixed("ababa", "ba") returns {found[0]}.')
